name: concept-to-refined-plan
description: Expands a user concept into parallel plan versions via different models, synthesizes them into a master plan, then runs n iterative improvement rounds each starting from a fresh context.

children.name: expand-concept
children.prompt: Read the user's raw concept from ctx.input.prompt. Produce a detailed initial plan document covering: objectives, key components, technical requirements, implementation approach, open questions, and success criteria. This document will seed three independent planning agents.

children.name: plan-version-analytical
children.prompt: You receive the expanded concept from expand-concept. Generate a comprehensive plan version optimised for rigour and completeness. Prioritise technical correctness, edge-case coverage, and long-term maintainability. Be exhaustive.

children.name: plan-version-pragmatic
children.prompt: You receive the expanded concept from expand-concept. Generate a comprehensive plan version optimised for speed-to-value and pragmatism. Prioritise what can ship first, iterative delivery, and minimal viable scope without sacrificing correctness.

children.name: plan-version-creative
children.prompt: You receive the expanded concept from expand-concept. Generate a comprehensive plan version that challenges assumptions and introduces unconventional approaches. Propose creative architectural choices, novel tooling, or alternative framings that the other plans might miss.

children.name: synthesize-master-plan
children.prompt: You have three plan versions: plan-version-analytical, plan-version-pragmatic, and plan-version-creative. Compare them systematically: identify each version's strengths, unique insights, and blind spots. Then synthesise the best elements into a single master plan that is more complete and balanced than any individual version. Explain which parts came from which version and why.

children.name: improve-round-1
children.prompt: Fresh context. Your only input is the master plan from synthesize-master-plan. Read it as a critical reviewer. Identify the 3-5 most significant weaknesses, gaps, or inconsistencies. Produce a revised plan that addresses each one. Output the full improved plan text.

children.name: improve-round-2
children.prompt: Fresh context. Your only input is the improved plan from improve-round-1. Read it as a critical reviewer. Identify the 3-5 most significant remaining weaknesses, gaps, or inconsistencies. Produce a revised plan that addresses each one. Output the full improved plan text.

children.name: improve-round-3
children.prompt: Fresh context. Your only input is the improved plan from improve-round-2. This is the final improvement pass. Identify any remaining rough edges, ambiguities, or missing details. Polish the plan into a final, publication-ready document. Output the complete final plan.

goal: A software project that takes a user concept, converts it to a detailed plan and then creates 3 versions of the plan from the concept using different models, then sends those plans to a synthesis stage that tells the original model to compare and synthesize these other versions into a master best-of-breed plan. Then that plan is put in an improvement loop that triggers n rounds of improvements, starting from a fresh context window each time.
